title: Big Animals
text:
Lions are big wild animals. They live in Africa. Lions eat meat. They sleep for many hours every day.

Elephants are also very big. They have long trunks. Elephants live in groups with their families. They drink a lot of water.

questions.text: Which animal probably hunts other animals for food?
Why are elephants probably not alone most of the time?

vocabulary.definition: living in nature and not controlled by people
the food from an animal's body
a number of animals or people together

paragraph_translations: Los leones son animales salvajes grandes. Viven en África. Los leones comen carne. Duermen muchas horas cada día.
Los elefantes también son muy grandes. Tienen trompas largas. Los elefantes viven en grupos con sus familias. Beben mucha agua.
